nodes.name: ic_launcher.xml
nodes.summary: Android adaptive icon launcher XML for the Tauri desktop app, referencing foreground and background drawables for API 26+ devices.

nodes.name: ic_launcher_background.xml
nodes.summary: Android color resource XML defining the background color for the adaptive launcher icon.

nodes.name: icon.icns
nodes.summary: macOS application icon bundle (ICNS format) used by the Tauri desktop binary for the dock and window title bar.
nodes.languageNotes: Binary ICNS format; multi-resolution icon container for macOS.

nodes.name: installer.nsi
nodes.summary: NSIS installer script for the Windows Waggle OS desktop binary, defining installation pages, file copying, registry entries, and uninstaller logic.
nodes.languageNotes: NSIS (Nullsoft Scriptable Install System) script controlling the Windows installer wizard flow.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder file to track the resources directory in git for Tauri bundled resource assets.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder file to track the native resources directory in git for platform-specific native binaries.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder file reserving the ONNX Runtime native library directory for ML inference support in the Tauri desktop app.

nodes.name: main.rs
nodes.summary: Rust entry point for the Tauri desktop application; delegates all logic to the waggle_lib crate's run() function.
nodes.languageNotes: Minimal Rust main.rs pattern: all Tauri setup is in a library crate (waggle_lib), keeping the binary thin.

nodes.name: tailwind.config.ts
nodes.summary: Tailwind CSS configuration for the Tauri desktop app shell, setting content paths for purging unused styles.

nodes.name: auto-update.test.ts
nodes.summary: Test suite validating the Tauri auto-update flow, verifying package versions, update manifests, and installer artifact integrity across platforms.

nodes.name: cockpit-agent-intelligence.test.ts
nodes.summary: Test suite for the cockpit agent intelligence display logic, verifying status formatting, reason label rendering, and activity indicator behavior.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration for the Tauri desktop shell, defining manual chunk splitting for vendor code (React, Tauri APIs) to optimize bundle size.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses manualChunks to separate react-vendor and tauri-api into distinct bundles, reducing main chunk size for the desktop binary.

nodes.name: background.js
nodes.summary: Browser extension service worker handling authentication header retrieval, health checks against the Waggle sidecar API, and memory save operations via Chrome extension message passing.

nodes.name: content.js
nodes.summary: Browser extension content script injected into web pages to extract page text and title for memory capture.

nodes.name: popup.js
nodes.summary: Browser extension popup UI controller managing connection status display, active tab content reading, and triggered memory save operations (page, link, selection) via Chrome runtime messaging.

nodes.name: eslint.config.js
nodes.summary: ESLint flat config for the apps/web React frontend, enabling TypeScript and React Hooks rules with browser globals.

nodes.name: playwright-fixture.ts
nodes.summary: Minimal Playwright test fixture barrel that re-exports test and expect from @playwright/test for use across E2E test files.

nodes.name: playwright.config.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright E2E configuration for the apps/web frontend, setting the base URL and browser project targets.

nodes.name: postcss.config.js
nodes.summary: PostCSS configuration for the apps/web frontend, enabling Tailwind CSS processing.

nodes.name: robots.txt
nodes.summary: Robots.txt directive file for the Waggle OS web app, controlling crawler access to the deployed frontend.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Developer guide for the persona bee sprite assets, documenting style guidelines, regeneration commands using AI image generation, and per-persona prompt actions for updating the 13+ persona icons.

nodes.name: VoiceApp.tsx
nodes.summary: Placeholder React component for the Voice app OS shell, rendering a coming-soon UI stub within the Waggle desktop workspace.

nodes.name: aspect-ratio.tsx
nodes.summary: Thin re-export wrapper around the @radix-ui/react-aspect-ratio primitive, exposing AspectRatio as a named Hive DS UI component.

nodes.name: collapsible.tsx
nodes.summary: Re-export barrel for the @radix-ui/react-collapsible primitives, exposing Collapsible, CollapsibleTrigger, and CollapsibleContent as named Hive DS UI components.

nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Global CSS stylesheet for the Waggle OS web app defining the Hive design system tokens (honey, hive-950, accent/violet), typography scale, dark/light theme CSS variables, component utility classes, and base resets.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CSS custom properties (variables) for Hive DS semantic tokens; structured with @layer base/components/utilities for Tailwind compatibility.
